_about: Practice sentences per noun and role (subject, object, preposition, possession), gated by fil.nouns.sentence_gate and read by a blind reviewer.

example.en: The foundations were strong.

critique.note: Bare 'القواعد' reads as 'the rules' (MSA default sense). Fix: كَانَتْ قَوَاعِدُ الْمَبْنَى قَوِيَّةً / The foundations of the building were strong.

example.en: The engineer examined the foundations of the house.

critique.note: Content: 'قواعد البيت' echoes Quran 2:127 (القواعد من البيت, the Kaaba). Fix: فَحَصَ الْمُهَنْدِسُ قَوَاعِدَ الْمَبْنَى / ...foundations of the building / temelje zgrade.

example.en: The house stands on strong foundations.

critique.note: Content: البيت + قواعد evokes Quran 2:127 (Kaaba foundations). Fix: يَقُومُ الْمَبْنَى عَلَى قَوَاعِدَ قَوِيَّةٍ / The building stands on strong foundations / Zgrada stoji na jakim temeljima.

example.en: The building of the foundations is difficult.

example.bs: Život je bio težak u selu.

example.en: The work improved the family's livelihood.
The father works for the livelihood.

critique.note: 'يعمل الأب للمعيشة' is unidiomatic; en 'works for the livelihood' awkward. Fix: تَحَدَّثَ الْأَبُ عَنِ الْمَعِيشَةِ / The father talked about living costs / Otac je govorio o životnim troškovima; or يَعْمَلُ الْأَبُ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْمَعِيشَةِ / works to make a living / radi za život.

example.en: The level of the livelihood improved.

critique.note: مستوى المعيشة = standard of living; en 'level of the livelihood' and bs 'Nivo života' are unnatural. Fix: en The standard of living improved. bs Životni standard se poboljšao. (glosses: مستوى=standard/standard, المعيشة=of living/životni)

example.en: The father spoke about the family's livelihood.
example.bs: Otac je govorio o životu porodice.

example.en: The standard of living improved.

critique.note: Grammar fine (مستوى المعيشة = standard of living), but gloss for الْمَعِيشَةِ "of the livelihood" does not match the translation; fix en gloss to "of living" (bs "životni" ok).

example.en: The source of the livelihood is agriculture.

critique.note: Arabic is correct and idiomatic: maṣdaru l-maʿīšati is a construct with the genitive possessor, and az-zirāʿatu is the nominative predicate. bs 'Izvor života' reads as 'source of life', not livelihood. en 'the livelihood' is unnatural. Fix: bs 'Poljoprivreda je izvor egzistencije.' (gloss: egzistencije / za život), en 'The source of livelihood is agriculture.'
